description: A setup wizard script for initializing data and configurations in an ERPNext system, including default records, settings, and templates.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Main function to initialize various setup data including domains, item groups, salary components, leave types, designations, territories, customer and supplier groups, modes of payment, activity types, attributes, issue priorities, job sources, email accounts, party types, opportunity types, project types, offer terms, print headings, assessment groups, share types, market segments, sales stages, warehouse types, industry types, lead sources, sales partner types, email templates, and more.

methods.name: set_more_defaults
methods.description: Performs additional setup tasks such as updating selling, buying, HR defaults, item variant settings, UOM data, and global search configurations.

methods.name: update_selling_defaults
methods.description: Updates default settings for selling, such as customer master name, sales order requirements, and update frequency.

methods.name: update_buying_defaults
methods.description: Updates default settings for buying, including supplier master name, purchase order requirements, and rate maintenance.

methods.name: update_hr_defaults
methods.description: Sets HR system defaults like employee creation method, leave and interview notification templates, and reminder settings.

methods.name: update_item_variant_settings
methods.description: Configures item variant settings to set default fields and behaviors.

methods.name: add_uom_data
methods.description: Loads and inserts units of measure (UOM) data and conversion factors from JSON files into the database.

methods.name: install_company
methods.description: Sets up fiscal year and company records based on provided arguments.

methods.name: install_post_company_fixtures
methods.description: Creates departmental structure and hierarchy for the company.

methods.name: install_defaults
methods.description: Creates default price lists, enables default currency, sets global defaults, active domains, stock settings, and bank accounts.

methods.name: create_bank_account
methods.description: Creates a bank account record for the company if specified.

methods.name: update_shopping_cart_settings
methods.description: Configures shopping cart settings for the company.

methods.name: get_fy_details
methods.description: Generates fiscal year string based on start and end dates.
